about: Extension (lowercase) to Content-Type for the axiom-static-bundle/v1 manifest, shared by the CLI (cli/src/commands/deploy_bundle.rs CONTENT_TYPES) and the dashboard (static/js/deployments-core.js CONTENT_TYPES). Every pair passes the server's checkContentType (axiom-backend internal/adapters/hosting/manifest.go). Another extension is refused locally; a name without an extension is text/plain (application/json for /.well-known/apple-app-site-association). The AxiomCore and axiom-frontend copies are byte-identical.
